### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                          |
| ----- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | reverse, inverse, opposite                                                       |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to reverse, to invert, to flip, to turn sth. on its head                         |
| ~a    | *psv.* | flipped, reversed                                                                |
| ~an   | *adj.* | anti-, counter-, inverted, flipped, opposite, upside down, turned over, backward |
| ~un   | *adv.* | backwards, in reverse                                                            |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 逆, a picture of a person standing on a road/floor upside down.
- you can also imagine a certain ==amanojaku== character standing on the ceiling of a room ;)
#### Meaning
Ambiguity warning: vertical or sideways?
#### Sound
- Related to **kso** (not)
